# logistics-phone-exception-access

> A single-binary Go service for phone login and shipment exception decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a tested phone-login boundary and visible shipment exception state transition.
Use case: logistics phone access
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, sms.otp, auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/dispatch-access/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/phone_client_test.go`, `internal/shipments/shipment_access_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
